T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),"-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x",*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init","-q");d=r/"kb"/"_self"/"backlog";d.mkdir(parents=True)

(r/"x.txt").write_text("x\n");g("add","-A");g("commit","-qm","i");(r/"x.txt").write_text("y\n")

files=g("show","--name-only","--format=","HEAD").split();msg=g("log","-1","--format=%B")
ok=files==["kb/_self/backlog/ST-aaaaaaaa.json"] and "KB-Work: ST-aaaaaaaa" in msg and "reworded" in (d/"ST-aaaaaaaa.json").read_text()
